CustomField.description: Which fields changed in Salesforce and have not yet reached the source system - SyncField names joined by semicolons, e.g. STATUS;TITLE. WorkItemTriggerHandler adds to it on a user edit; WorkItemSyncService pushes exactly these and, after re-reading the row under a lock, removes only the ones the source confirmed, so an edit made mid-push is neither lost nor marked Synced early. A field the source refused stays listed until a later push succeeds. Inbound sync does not overwrite a field while it is listed here. Internal bookkeeping: on no DTO and edited by no user.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Fields waiting to reach the source system. Maintained by the sync; not editable.
CustomField.label: Pending Push Fields
